title: release-engineering-meeting-notes-2026-11-24
content:
Attendees: Michael Chen (owner), Aisha Raman, Diego Martinez, Priya Kapoor, Samir Patel, Emma Liu (SRE on-call), QA: Rahul

TL;DR:
- Preparing for 2026.11 release train targeted for 2026-11-30 22:00 UTC production window.
- Hotfix HF-578 (auth cookie expiry causing 502s for long-lived sessions) deployed to prod canary 2026-11-23, full rollout completed 2026-11-24 03:10 UTC. No rollback required; incident follow-up noted.
- Branch cut for next feature roll (feature flags + A/B) scheduled 2026-11-26 08:00 PT.
- Changelog draft needs final QA and product sign-off by 2026-11-26 EOD.

Notes / Discussion:
1) Hotfix HF-578 postmortem (Diego)
   - Symptom: 502 spike in auth-proxy for sessions >24h, intermittent. Detected 11/22 21:40 UTC by alarms (auth-502-rate +4.9%).
   - Root cause: cookie parsing path returned nil when optional header present; regression from PR #4720 (session-refactor).
   - Mitigation timeline: canary 11/23 02:00 UTC -> metrics looked stable after canary; full push 11/24 03:10 UTC during low traffic window.
   - Impact: ~0.6% of total requests during incident window; SLO impact minimal but customer-facing errors observed for 2 customers (CS handled).
   - Action items: add regression unit test for cookie parsing (Priya, due 2026-11-27), add synthetic test to detect 502 spike in auth-proxy (Emma, due 2026-12-01).

2) Release 2026.11 train (Michael)
   - Target prod deploy: 2026-11-30 22:00 UTC (standard Tue/Thu window is Tue, but needed for calendar alignment).
   - Branch cut: 2026-11-26 08:00 PT. After branch cut only critical fixes to main.
   - Candidate builds: platform@release-2026-11.30, runtime@v3.7.1-rc2, console@release-11-30.
   - Must-ship items: autoscaling policy changes (PR #4812), canary monitoring improvements (PR #4807), billing tokens fix (PR #4799).
   - Risky items flagged for next train: Batching engine refactor (Samir) — still experimental; exclude from this train unless green across integration tests by 11/25 EOD.

3) Canary strategy and telemetry (Emma/SRE)
   - Canary start: 11/30 20:30 UTC (90m pre-window). Canary traffic target: 2% global, distributed across three regions.
   - Success criteria: 99.9pct availability, error rate <= baseline + 0.1pp, p95 latency within 15% of baseline.
   - Automated rollback triggers: auth-502 > 0.3% sustained for 5m, tokens-errors > 0.2% sustained 3m, CPU OOM rate > baseline*2.
   - Observability: add short-term dashboards for train: per-route latency, token cost deltas, kv-cache hit rate. Diego to add dashboard and share link by 2026-11-25.

4) Changelog and external comms (Priya/Product)
   - Draft changelog at https://confluence.redwood.ai/pages/REL-2026-11-release-plan (linked). Needs product sign-off and legal review for the enterprise release notes.
   - Customer-facing highlights: reduced inference tail latency for long contexts, dedicated capacity SLA clarification, hotfix HF-578 summary.
   - Release notes to be published alongside deploy and an email to customers with opt-in for early access. Priya to coordinate with GTM; deadline 2026-11-29 17:00 UTC.

5) Backports and hotfix policy (Michael)
   - Reminder: Only security and high-severity (P0/P1) bugs are eligible for fast-track hotfixes to main after branch cut.
   - HF workflow: create branch hotfix/hf-<id> -> PR -> cross-team sign-off (SRE + QA + product) -> sign-off tag and cherry-pick to release branch.
   - We observed last-minute hotfix churn in Oct due to ambiguous severity; Engineering leads to re-clarify triage thresholds in Confluence (owner Michael, due 2026-12-03).

6) Change log items to include (working list)
   - HF-578 auth cookie parsing fix — SF, Diego
   - Autoscaling policy improvements (PR #4812) — Samir
   - Billing token resilience fix (PR #4799) — Aisha
   - Canary monitoring improvements (PR #4807) — Diego
   - Minor console UI adjustments for release toggles — UX (tracked in UX-332)

7) Blockers / Help needed
   - Integration E2E flaky on runtime sequences (Samir). Root cause likely timing in KV cache warmup. Needs infra test VM access to reproduce spike; infra team to grant access (request opened: INFRA-TICKET-128).
   - Legal needs a quick description for enterprise note (Priya to draft and pass to Legal).

Action Items (owners + due dates):
- Priya: Finalize changelog and customer email draft (due 2026-11-29 17:00 UTC).
- Diego: Dashboard for train telemetry + share link (due 2026-11-25).
- Priya & Product: Legal review of enterprise notes (due 2026-11-27).
- Samir: Stabilize KV cache integration test or document workaround, escalate infra access (due 2026-11-26).
- Priya: Merge release notes into Confluence and tag release manager (due 2026-11-29).
- Priya/Aisha: QA final smoke test matrix for 11/30 deploy (due 2026-11-28 EOD).
- Michael: Update hotfix triage doc in Confluence (due 2026-12-03).

Parking lot / follow-ups:
- Evaluate opt-in staged rollout for heavy-traffic customers (post-release).
- Consider extending canary time window for cross-region feature rollouts.
- Review cost impact of batching changes in Redwood Optimize (Samir to prepare cost delta table).

Meeting adjourned. Next sync: weekly release engineering meeting 2026-12-01 16:00 PT.

Quick links:
- Release plan: https://confluence.redwood.ai/pages/REL-2026-11-release-plan
- Hotfix PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/4821
- Incident log (HF-578): JIRA-HF-578

Notes on doc style: working notes, will convert to final postmortem and release doc after action items closed.
